item.description:
Most teams building an AI agent face the same fork early: make it general-purpose, or make it narrow and specialized. The honest tradeoff looks like this.
A narrow agent, built for one job like triaging support tickets or drafting PR descriptions, is easy to evaluate. You know what good output looks like, so you can measure it and trust it faster.
